subject: Build combined ON-vs-OFF cost-bounded bench over featurebench problems
description:
Build the new canonical eval (see note:note-mqjmq2cbdy3). Extend scripts/bench-economy.js (or a sibling runner) to iterate the EXISTING featurebench problem set (bench-questions.jsonl, 73 probes: question, gold, category, seeded note) — do NOT author new scenarios — and run two arms per problem:

ON arm = PRODUCTION-FAITHFUL (the #1 acceptance criterion). The probe is a task node with the relevant note(s) wired as DAG context_deps exactly as production autowire+judge would (NOT hand-pasted into the prompt). The agent consults via the GATE-FIRST TIERED path: search_knowledge(gated:true, task_key) — DAG context_deps inject first (tier:dag, score 1.0, bypass gate); RAG fills remaining slots under the context-need gate; on decision:abstain proceed with NO injected context and do NOT re-call gated. Also get_dependency_summaries (GET /task/context) delivers Tier-1 DAG summaries. Two-tier budget (summaries first, full on demand). Token CEILING ~500k = runaway guard only; ON solving cheaply (e.g. 100k) is fine. Measure accuracy (LLM-judge) + ACTUAL token spend X. Do NOT replicate the existing ON_PREAMBLE forced-ungated-search shortcut — it is NOT production-faithful.

OFF arm = pure agentic, clean env (no MCP/KB/.graph/ORCH_*), cap = ON's ACTUAL spend X on that problem; run till solved or cap hit.

Grade: the validated LLM-judge (bench/zonoid_bench/report.py judge_correctness + judge.py claude_p) on each arm's final answer vs gold. Per-problem fused record: ON_solved, ON_cost, OFF_solved, OFF_cost, OFF_solved_within_budget (= OFF_solved && OFF_cost <= ON_cost), category. Aggregate report: ON acc+cost, OFF-within-budget rate, memory-win count (ON_solved && !OFF_solved_within_budget). Contamination self-reveals (config/invariant -> OFF matches cheaply; decision/gotcha -> memory win).

REUSE bench-economy.js worktree/agentic-ON-OFF/cost/cap machinery + featurebench problems + LLM-judge. NEW piece: real-time token-cap enforcement (stream token usage, kill ON at ceiling / OFF at X) — today only wall-clock timeout + post-hoc compare exist. summary:
Built the canonical combined ON-vs-OFF cost-bounded agentic bench. files_changed: [bench/zonoid_bench/combined_bench.py] (new, 889 lines; commit 78beca6 on orch/attempt/e90ac60e-72a4-49e3-b6c4-cdcdc2219c2f-1). Iterates the EXISTING featurebench problem set (bench-questions.jsonl, 92 probes); per problem runs ON+OFF, grades both final answers with the validated LLM-judge (report.judge_correctness/judge.claude_p), emits fused records {ON_solved,ON_cost,OFF_solved,OFF_cost,OFF_solved_within_budget,memory_win,category,...} + an aggregate report (ON acc+cost, OFF-within-budget rate, memory-win count) overall and per-category.

ON-ARM PARITY (audited lib/mcp-core.js + routes/task.js + arms.py): reuses arms.run_canonical_wiring — the production memory path call-for-call: mint probe as a TASK node -> POST /overlay/status drives autowire seeding NOTE->probe context_deps at cosine>=0.55 -> GET /judge/next pulls the candidate edge-set -> EdgeJudge keep/prune -> keepEdge promotes weight-0 candidate in place -> GET /task/context (= get_dependency_summaries Tier-1 DAG) read of the frozen judged context, then RAG fill via GET /search note-only (= search_knowledge tiered: DAG injects first, RAG fills remaining). Did NOT replicate bench-economy.js ON_PREAMBLE forced-UNGATED search. Verified live: probe 0 shows ON_n_dag=1, ON_judge_idle=False (eager judge KEPT a DAG edge), ON answers correctly; cold OFF says 'I don't know' = memory win.

COST: bench-economy.js weighted formula (input + output*5 + cache_read*0.1 + cache_creation*1.25). Captures full 4-class usage from claude -p --output-format json (arms.claude_p_with_usage dropped cache_read/cache_creation — restored). ON ~500k ceiling is a runaway guard only (--on-ceiling), not a target.

TOKEN CAPS: POST-HOC, not real-time. A single non-streaming claude -p completion cannot be killed mid-generation by external token count, and on Windows the claude .cmd shim makes child-process-group SIGKILL unreliable. OFF_solved_within_budget :=

subject: Build combined ON-vs-OFF cost-bounded bench over featurebench problems
description:
Build the new canonical eval (see note:note-mqjmq2cbdy3). Extend scripts/bench-economy.js (or a sibling runner) to iterate the EXISTING featurebench problem set (bench-questions.jsonl, 73 probes: question, gold, category, seeded note) — do NOT author new scenarios — and run two arms per problem:

ON arm = PRODUCTION-FAITHFUL (the #1 acceptance criterion). The probe is a task node with the relevant note(s) wired as DAG context_deps exactly as production autowire+judge would (NOT hand-pasted into the prompt). The agent consults via the GATE-FIRST TIERED path: search_knowledge(gated:true, task_key) — DAG context_deps inject first (tier:dag, score 1.0, bypass gate); RAG fills remaining slots under the context-need gate; on decision:abstain proceed with NO injected context and do NOT re-call gated. Also get_dependency_summaries (GET /task/context) delivers Tier-1 DAG summaries. Two-tier budget (summaries first, full on demand). Token CEILING ~500k = runaway guard only; ON solving cheaply (e.g. 100k) is fine. Measure accuracy (LLM-judge) + ACTUAL token spend X. Do NOT replicate the existing ON_PREAMBLE forced-ungated-search shortcut — it is NOT production-faithful.

OFF arm = pure agentic, clean env (no MCP/KB/.graph/ORCH_*), cap = ON's ACTUAL spend X on that problem; run till solved or cap hit.

Grade: the validated LLM-judge (bench/zonoid_bench/report.py judge_correctness + judge.py claude_p) on each arm's final answer vs gold. Per-problem fused record: ON_solved, ON_cost, OFF_solved, OFF_cost, OFF_solved_within_budget (= OFF_solved && OFF_cost <= ON_cost), category. Aggregate report: ON acc+cost, OFF-within-budget rate, memory-win count (ON_solved && !OFF_solved_within_budget). Contamination self-reveals (config/invariant -> OFF matches cheaply; decision/gotcha -> memory win).

REUSE bench-economy.js worktree/agentic-ON-OFF/cost/cap machinery + featurebench problems + LLM-judge. NEW piece: real-time token-cap enforcement (stream token usage, kill ON at ceiling / OFF at X) — today only wall-clock timeout + post-hoc compare exist. HONESTY BAR: gold/evidence never enter ON or OFF context; notes live in the KB among others, surfaced only via the production retrieval path. Commit all changes onto orch/attempt/<key> before complete_task.

subject: Build combined ON-vs-OFF cost-bounded bench over featurebench problems
description:
Build the new canonical eval (see note:note-mqjmq2cbdy3). Extend scripts/bench-economy.js (or a sibling runner) to iterate the EXISTING featurebench problem set (bench-questions.jsonl, 73 probes: question, gold, category, seeded note) — do NOT author new scenarios — and run two arms per problem:

ON arm = PRODUCTION-FAITHFUL (the #1 acceptance criterion). The probe is a task node with the relevant note(s) wired as DAG context_deps exactly as production autowire+judge would (NOT hand-pasted into the prompt). The agent consults via the GATE-FIRST TIERED path: search_knowledge(gated:true, task_key) — DAG context_deps inject first (tier:dag, score 1.0, bypass gate); RAG fills remaining slots under the context-need gate; on decision:abstain proceed with NO injected context and do NOT re-call gated. Also get_dependency_summaries (GET /task/context) delivers Tier-1 DAG summaries. Two-tier budget (summaries first, full on demand). Token CEILING ~500k = runaway guard only; ON solving cheaply (e.g. 100k) is fine. Measure accuracy (LLM-judge) + ACTUAL token spend X. Do NOT replicate the existing ON_PREAMBLE forced-ungated-search shortcut — it is NOT production-faithful.

OFF arm = pure agentic, clean env (no MCP/KB/.graph/ORCH_*), cap = ON's ACTUAL spend X on that problem; run till solved or cap hit.

Grade: the validated LLM-judge (bench/zonoid_bench/report.py judge_correctness + judge.py claude_p) on each arm's final answer vs gold. Per-problem fused record: ON_solved, ON_cost, OFF_solved, OFF_cost, OFF_solved_within_budget (= OFF_solved && OFF_cost <= ON_cost), category. Aggregate report: ON acc+cost, OFF-within-budget rate, memory-win count (ON_solved && !OFF_solved_within_budget). Contamination self-reveals (config/invariant -> OFF matches cheaply; decision/gotcha -> memory win).

REUSE bench-economy.js worktree/agentic-ON-OFF/cost/cap machinery + featurebench problems + LLM-judge. NEW piece: real-time token-cap enforcement (stream token usage, kill ON at ceiling / OFF at X) — today only wall-clock timeout + post-hoc compare exist. HONESTY BAR: gold/evidence never enter ON or OFF context; notes live in the KB among others, surfaced only via the production retrieval path.
